control_parameters.single_pass_semantics: lock direction and in-range endpoint; PL emits continuous 4us/20ms ramp; actual face center ends motion using QUIESCE, without a reverse target
control_parameters.brief_face_gap: STOP after current complete pulse; no PS braking path in this mode
control_parameters.step_scope: emitted pulse width per 20ms FPGA frame, not target-register delta
control_parameters.source_displacement_bound: at most 4us per hardware frame before original source expiry; replaces 4us/image PS budget
control_parameters.authority_deadline: minimum of image source plus 250ms and detection anchor plus 500ms
control_parameters.fresh_image_low_lease_renewal: every distinct admitted post-ARM actual face immediately renews the same endpoint using original source/anchor deadlines; ticks never renew
control_parameters.initial_in_zone_pwm: off; prepare ARM on confirmed face; no COMMIT until actual face-edge displacement
control_parameters.initial_equal_target_pwm: off until a distinct trajectory target is ready
control_parameters.initial_insufficient_budget: no PWM; reset unexecuted trajectory; retain original deadline
control_parameters.shutdown_order: verified motor STOP before HTTP reader cleanup
control_parameters.live_report_storage: latest-only background filesystem writes; immutable JSON; final proof after STOP and writer exit
control_parameters.visual_loss_stop: PL QUIESCE completes current pulse only; original hardware expiry remains
control_parameters.trajectory_authority: only new actual face images renew endpoint lease; original image/anchor deadline; no old-image tick renewal
control_parameters.zone_hold: initial inside means no output; after center QUIESCE retains final emitted width and ends PWM
jerk_exceptions: hardware slew profile has no explicit acceleration/jerk trajectory constraint
control_parameters.feedback_reference: current actual face center completes the latched hardware ramp; no face velocity correction, future prediction or fixed mechanical home

control.position_filter: OneEuro for face admission; not a pulse-position trajectory

result.width_trace_scope: register readbacks, not an external pin waveform or shaft measurement
result.source_displacement_bound: hardware 4us/frame inside original image/anchor lease; not the old 4us/image budget

input_timing.scope: distinct READY sources and admitted-source counts; rolling 256-source timing; not mechanical latency

live_writer.scope: one pending immutable live snapshot; final proof is written only after STOP and writer exit

reader_queue.scope: reader-to-control queue; approximate concurrent depth, original packets and fault order preserved

pre_stop_result.width_trace_scope: register readbacks, not an external pin waveform or shaft measurement
